import math

d = math.radians
c10, c50, c70 = (math.cos(d(x)) for x in (10, 50, 70))
s10, s50, s70 = (math.sin(d(x)) for x in (10, 50, 70))

val = 6 * c10 * c50 * c70 + s10 * s50 * s70
claim = (6 * math.sqrt(3) + 1) / 8

# Component identities: cos10 cos50 cos70 = sqrt(3)/8, sin10 sin50 sin70 = 1/8
p1 = c10 * c50 * c70
p2 = s10 * s50 * s70

print("computed value:", val)
print("claimed value :", claim)
print("cos product   :", p1, "vs sqrt3/8 =", math.sqrt(3) / 8)
print("sin product   :", p2, "vs 1/8 =", 1 / 8)
print("abs diff:", abs(val - claim))

ok = (abs(val - claim) < 1e-12
      and abs(p1 - math.sqrt(3) / 8) < 1e-12
      and abs(p2 - 1 / 8) < 1e-12)
# Note: this is a high-precision floating-point evaluation of a single
# closed-form expression (not sampling of a universal claim); the identities
# also follow from sin x sin(60-x) sin(60+x) = sin(3x)/4 at x=10 and 20.
print("CHECK PASS" if ok else "CHECK FAIL")
